Title: Storage management

First, the order is read from the automatic order management system.
Then, it's checked if the first product from the order is in stock.
If it's in stock then it's withdrawn from the warehouse.
However, if it's not in stock then it's reordered from the wholesaler.
Note, that if it was necessary to wait more then 10 days for the arrival of the  product then a delivery delay penalty is automatically demanded from the wholesaler.
After the ordered product has arrived it's registered in the stock management system.
Finally, it's checked if the whole order is ready for shipment.
If the order is ready for shipment, a courier is requested and the products are packed simultaneously and finally shipped.
If it isn't then the next product from the order is selected and the process starts again with checking if this order is in stock or not.

result.rule: When the description says that items are processed iteratively, that overall completion is checked after an item is processed, and that an incomplete result leads to selecting another item and repeating the item-level check: Model the item-processing outcomes to converge before the overall completion check, and route the incomplete outcome through the next-item selection back to the item-level check.

When the description states that the process ends under one condition but, under another, continues with additional or recurring work.: Model the continuing alternative as a branch connected to the existing process flow, rather than as a detached start-to-end chain.

When the description says a decision about whether to proceed depends on replies from multiple participants, and an earlier choice is repeated when the decision condition is not met.: Model an intermediate catch event for the replies before evaluating the condition, and loop an unmet result back to the activity that makes the choice.

When the description says that an external response or completion is awaited while other work can proceed in parallel: Model the awaited response or completion as an intermediate catch event on a parallel branch, and synchronize that branch with the other work before continuing.
